name: HMX-17c Silfa
source:
A robot, she is model HMX-17c, making her a "sister" of sorts to "[url=/c15124]Ilfa[/url]" and "Milfa". She was previously only mentioned in the game. She was shipped to [url=/c15061]Takaaki[/url]'s home to serve as his personal maid. Her housekeeping performance however leaves a lot to be desired, plus she's quite emotional for a robot, to the point that she needs to be "disciplined" by [url=/c15124]HMX-17a Ilfa[/url]. She is however extremely shy, if not downright scared, when trying to interact with other people in the society, to the point of being called a "hikki(komori)" by [url=/c15079]Harumi[/url] and has a tendency to cover herself with and stay underneath a cardboard box all the time. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_To_Heart_series_characters#To_Heart_2]Wikipedia[/url].]
